# Wag'n Tails

> > Wag'n Tails designs and sells custom mobile grooming vans with 30+ years of industry expertise, offering financing, equipment, and business support for professional pet groomers.

Wag'n Tails is a leading manufacturer of mobile grooming vans built on Ford, Mercedes-Benz, and RAM chassis. The company provides complete solutions including van customization, financing options, grooming equipment, and ongoing customer support for mobile pet grooming businesses.

## Van Models & Catalog

- [All Vehicles](https://wagntails.com/all-vehicles): Complete catalog of mobile grooming van models and customization options
- [Pet Pro+ Groom Van](https://wagntails.com/all-vehicles/pet-pro-groom-van): Pet Pro+ premium solo grooming van on Ford Transit 350HD chassis
- [Pet Stylist Elite Groom Van](https://wagntails.com/all-vehicles/pet-stylist-elite-groom-van): Pet Stylist Elite largest grooming van with 120+ sq ft and bathroom
- [Supreme Groom Van](https://wagntails.com/all-vehicles/supreme-groom-van): Supreme Groom luxury Mercedes Sprinter grooming van with advanced tech
- [Quantum Groom Van](https://wagntails.com/all-vehicles/quantum-groom-van): Quantum Groom luxury Mercedes Sprinter van for single groomers
- [Dyna Groom Van](https://wagntails.com/all-vehicles/dyna-groom-van): Dyna Groom value-driven grooming van with fuel efficiency and durability
- [Ultra Groom Van](https://wagntails.com/all-vehicles/ultra-groom-van): Ultra Groom economical RAM ProMaster van for cost-conscious groomers
- [Pre-Owned Grooming Vans](https://wagntails.com/pre-owned-grooming-vans): Used mobile grooming vans inventory with financing options available
